title: Single-pair infall from separation 9: far-field shape of the pair law in one run
pitch: One A-B pair released at rest at separation 9 (A at x=0.5, B at x=9.5, y=5), tracked for T=10 at dt=0.01. Under an r^-2.5 law the pair closes from r=9 to about 4.2 with no contact, so one run samples the force over a continuous range of separations. Prediction, written before the run: the effective K_A(B) at fixed P=2.5 falls by at least 5% from r=5 to r=8, and K_B(A)/K_A(B) stays 1.41 at every r. Falsified if the ratio drifts by more than 3% across the run, or if no single power law fits all windows at the tracker noise floor.
